issue_context.title: systemctl: list-dependencies: tree structure with `--all` is in disorder if it hits loop dependencies
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

Current HEAD (d59ce37c280bb1bcd8787c2b77b54d8fe69bf8d2)

### Used distribution

Arch Linux

### Linux kernel version used

_No response_

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

None

### Component

systemctl

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

The tree structure is complete.

### Unexpected behaviour you saw

![screenshot](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29118423/212295213-76e7ad98-f399-45ab-a4cf-10187c3ea21b.png)


### Steps to reproduce the problem

Use `systemctl list-dependencies --all` on a unit that has dependency loops.
